claim: Mutations in a hormone receptor can lead to therapeutic resistance.
source: Mutations in a hormone receptor can lead to therapeutic resistance by making it less able to bind and respond to hormone blocking drugs and by making it active, even when the hormome is not present.
evidence: This is a general statement about the relationship between mutations and therapeutic resistance, presented as an established fact in the abstract.

claim: Mutations in a hormone receptor can make it less able to bind hormone blocking drugs.
source: Mutations in a hormone receptor can lead to therapeutic resistance by making it less able to bind and respond to hormone blocking drugs and by making it active, even when the hormome is not present.
evidence: This describes a specific mechanism by which mutations cause resistance, stated as a factual assertion about receptor-drug binding.

claim: Mutations in a hormone receptor can make it less able to respond to hormone blocking drugs.
source: Mutations in a hormone receptor can lead to therapeutic resistance by making it less able to bind and respond to hormone blocking drugs and by making it active, even when the hormome is not present.
evidence: This describes a specific mechanism by which mutations cause resistance, stated as a factual assertion about receptor response to drugs.

claim: Mutations in a hormone receptor can make it active even when the hormone is not present.
source: Mutations in a hormone receptor can lead to therapeutic resistance by making it less able to bind and respond to hormone blocking drugs and by making it active, even when the hormome is not present.
evidence: This describes a specific mechanism of constitutive receptor activation caused by mutations, stated as a factual assertion.
